title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: The rollout description, policy paths and PowerShell controls are supported. Hold for two overstated documentation gaps: Microsoft documents consent behavior for auto-recorded meetings and requires Teams Premium for organizers using assigned meeting templates, without an exception for recording alone.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled | Disabled controls organizers' access to automatic recording.
claims.quote:

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the user policy that controls access to Record and transcribe automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center Auto recording policy access Record and transcribe automatically PowerShell UI. Read manage-teams-auto-recording and settings-policies-reference search excerpts; access policy is PowerShell-only, distinct from template enforcement and visibility.

claims.claim: The auto recording access policy can be applied to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can control whether organizers have access to the Record and transcribe automatically setting in meeting options, webinars, and town halls. You can only apply this policy setting to users and groups.

claims.claim: There is no admin policy for setting Record and transcribe automatically itself, as distinct from controlling access to it.
claims.quote: There isn't an admin policy for Record and transcribe automatically. However, to control whether organizers have the Record and transcribe automatically setting in their Meeting options, you can use the Auto recording policy in PowerShell.

claims.claim: Learn directs administrators to PowerShell or a meeting template to manage the automatic recording setting.
claims.quote: You must use PowerShell or a meeting template to manage this setting for organizers.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described how AutoRecording interacts with the newly separated automatic recording and transcription choices.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording new options webinars town halls ExplicitRecordingConsent sensitivity labels templates policy alignment. Read manage-teams-auto-recording and MC1508234; neither describes AutoRecording with the separated choices.
